scope: TorchFLIRT execution optimization; no BBR or FNIRT algorithm changes
timing_scope: already materialized input images; full schedule, optimization, resampling, device-to-host result; excludes input/output file I/O
cold_definition: first registration in fresh process; CUDA context and constructor setup precede timing
warm_definition: repeat full registration in same process; no fitted-matrix reuse
profile_timing: Separate instrumented registration excluded from performance timings
precision: float32 images/costs, float64 affine construction/inverse and NMI histogram; no FP16/BF16; TF32 defaults preserved, cost arithmetic does not use TF32 GEMM
schedule: Full 8/4/2/1 mm; angular search, candidate ordering, pruning and stopping retained
kernel_count_scope: Per-case complete profiles: WSL reports actual runtime launch calls without a device timeline; Linux H100 reports both runtime launch calls and device kernel events
transfer_count_scope: Total cudaMemcpyAsync runtime calls, potentially including device-to-device copies; no direction totals inferred where the device timeline is unavailable
